description: Paid API plans only (Developer, Startup, Growth, Enterprise): with a Free-plan key it answers KEY_PLAN_001 and nothing is charged. Rural land only: prices agricultural parcels in Spain (ES, PV, NA), small agricultural buildings allowed (sheds, farm stores, ponds, greenhouses), with crop_prices (EUR per hectare for each crop group of the parcel, with the number of sales behind it) and zone_prices.rural (the province farmland price per hectare). It is the price of the land; buildings are not valued (price_note). Housing, industrial or any other non-agricultural property is not supported and answers MKT_001 with nothing charged; so does rural land without a price, and any other country. One API call, charged only when a price comes back.

country.description: Optional country code. Rural land prices exist for ES, PV and NA; other countries answer MKT_001. Omit to auto-detect.
